recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source action is needed for FHIR-18006 unless FM later chooses an independent editorial refresh outside this reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-18006 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FM change request for PaymentReconciliation asking to change Scope and Usage text to generalize use to any payment and its breakdown.
initial_application: The request was historically applied in 4bc111798571c5d90b18cf42db9b70a05d603c60, which explicitly resolved GF#18006 and broadened the introduction from insurer-only goods-and-services payments to receivable amounts with ClaimResponse and Invoice examples. That application still retained bulk/payor framing that was later refined.
additional_context: PaymentReconciliation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-26601 expanded PaymentReconciliation to include patient payments, and the already-published combined-branch commit b08c1cf3de932ccba79704a7faddcdf889adcbe1 updated the same active narrative to remove bulk-only/payor-only framing and include insurer, other payor, direct patient, and third-party patient-payment language. Adjacent FHIR-18007 and FHIR-18008 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current narrative says PaymentReconciliation provides details, including amount, of a payment; allocates items being paid or adjusted; supports insurers, other payors, direct patient payments, and third-party payment collectors; and associates payments with Claims, Accounts, Invoices, Encounters, Contracts, and other financial exchanges and adjustments.
